failureCode.description: Stable failure code. forbidden: current permission refused or operator cancel; refused: retained evidence or qualification refused; conflict: changed inputs; retries-exhausted: server-side retries ended within the bounded window; receipt-missing: the job recorded success but custody holds no receipt (an integrity fault to report, not to retry).

oneOf.description: Retries ended or the job was refused, with a stable failure code.
